lines.text: Noah was a righteous man who walked with God, and he had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
God told Noah to make an ark of cypress wood with a roof, a side door, and three decks.
The LORD told Noah to enter the ark because He found him righteous, and rain would fall forty days and nights.
The fountains of the great deep burst forth, rain fell for forty days, and the LORD shut Noah in.
The waters covered the mountaintops to a depth of twenty cubits and prevailed upon the earth for 150 days.
